purpose.summary: This program is a prescription/receipt printing component (A5 format) for the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system used in Japanese medical institutions. It handles printing of prescription slips including patient insurance information, drug details, dosage quantities, and various medical billing data. It is part of the 'ORCHC02' prescription print subsystem.

notable_features: Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS (rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
Extensive revision history spanning 2002-2015 with version numbers
COPY statements referencing project-specific copybooks (HC02V02.INC, CPCOMMONPRT.INC)
16 CALL statements, 345 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No COMP-3 packed decimal usage despite financial/billing domain
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based I/O only
PRT-FILE with large record size PIC X(10000) for print output
OCCURS clauses for insurance combination and drug detail arrays
REDEFINES used for numeric/display conversion of quantities
Open source JMA ORCA project copyright notice
verdict.notes: The file is genuine production COBOL from the open-source ORCA medical receipt system developed by the Japan Medical Association (JMA). Japanese text in comments is encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake. The program has a long maintenance history (2002-2015) with many revision entries. No COPY body is shown (copybooks referenced externally). The single GOTO (goto_count=1) is typical of legacy COBOL. Zero COMP-3 is somewhat unusual for a billing system but not disqualifying.
